source.title: Ultra-wideband radar to measure in vivo muscle forces

reproduced_author_lme_outputs.scientific_interpretation: Independent extraction from LME_Data_Outputs.mat confirms author-reported metrics (R2 = 0.984 +/- 0.005, NRMSE = 3.28 +/- 0.58%) across all 30 intra-participant CV folds.

reproduced_author_lstm_outputs.scientific_interpretation: Independent extraction from LSTM_Data_Outputs.zip confirms author-reported fatigue LSTM metrics (R2 = 0.9882 +/- 0.0059, RMSE = 2.74 +/- 0.67%) across all 90 CV folds.

negative_values_details.interpretation: Small baseline offset fluctuations (ranging from -0.0207 to -0.00066 fraction of MVC, i.e., -2.07% to -0.07% MVC) during active runs near terminal knee extension (84.0 deg to 90.1 deg) with near-zero velocity (0.0 to 20.9 deg/s) and baseline sEMG (0.01 to 0.05) in participants 1, 3, 4, 5. Arising from dynamometer gravity-correction offset and 5 Hz low-pass filter transition ringing at the boundary of active contractions, rather than active negative torque or unverified hardware failure.

negative_sensor_drift_details.interpretation: Small baseline offset fluctuations (ranging from -0.0207 to -0.00066 fraction of MVC, i.e., -2.07% to -0.07% MVC) during active runs near terminal knee extension (84.0 deg to 90.1 deg) with near-zero velocity (0.0 to 20.9 deg/s) and baseline sEMG (0.01 to 0.05) in participants 1, 3, 4, 5. INTRA_SUBJECT_CV.definition: 5-fold cross-validation with interleaved 1-in-5 data points within each participant time series.
INTRA_SUBJECT_CV.mathematical_sampling: Test set for fold k consists of points t satisfying mod(t, 5) == offset_k (offsets: 4, 0, 1, 2, 3).
INTRA_SUBJECT_CV.leakage_mechanism: Temporal autocorrelation leakage across 10 Hz continuous dynamometer/radar signals. Adjacent test point t has neighbors t-1 and t+1 (100 ms apart) in train set.
INTRA_SUBJECT_CV.status_in_paper: Method used by Bird et al. (2026) for published LME (R2=0.984) and LSTM (R2=0.988).

BLOCKED_TEMPORAL_CV.definition: Holding out contiguous multi-second temporal blocks (e.g. 30 s blocks or individual runs) within each participant to mitigate adjacent sample autocorrelation.
BLOCKED_TEMPORAL_CV.leakage_mechanism: Reduces high-frequency temporal autocorrelation leakage, but remains participant-specific.
BLOCKED_TEMPORAL_CV.status_in_paper: Used in LSTM segment preprocessing, but within-participant.

LEAVE_ONE_SUBJECT_OUT.definition: Cross-subject validation holding out an entire participant (all runs/conditions), training strictly on the remaining N-1 participants.
LEAVE_ONE_SUBJECT_OUT.leakage_mechanism: Zero cross-subject leakage. Evaluates true population generalization to unseen human bodies.
LEAVE_ONE_SUBJECT_OUT.status_in_paper: NOT performed by Bird et al. (2026). Executed independently by SUBJECT-01.

AUTHOR_REPORTED_PRECOMPUTED_OUTPUTS.definition: Model performance extracted directly from author precomputed evaluation files (LME_Data_Outputs.mat, LSTM_Data_Outputs.zip).
AUTHOR_REPORTED_PRECOMPUTED_OUTPUTS.status_in_paper: Confirmed by independent recomputation (LME R2=0.9844, LSTM R2=0.9882).

FULL_MODEL_RETRAINING.definition: Retraining model pipelines from raw arrays with strict inner-fold feature extraction, normalization, and parameter fitting.
FULL_MODEL_RETRAINING.status_in_paper: Executed for all M0-M4 and UWB Ridge models across LOSO and intra-subject splits.

stage4_m4_falsification_mechanisms.mechanism_1_single_head_vs_net_joint_mom: Vastus lateralis B-mode ultrasound captures kinematics from only 1 of 4 quadriceps heads. Knee extension torque reflects the algebraic sum of vastus medialis, vastus intermedius, vastus lateralis, and rectus femoris (bi-articular), minus antagonist hamstring co-contraction. Surface EMG integrates overall neural drive better than single-muscle fascicle geometry.
stage4_m4_falsification_mechanisms.mechanism_2_parameter_unidentifiability: Anatomical moment arms d_MA(theta), tendon slack lengths, and optimal fascicle lengths L0 vary substantially across individuals. In cross-subject LOSO, pooled fixed parameters induce systematic bias on held-out subjects that degrades accuracy.
stage4_m4_falsification_mechanisms.mechanism_3_ultrasound_tracking_noise_pr: Multiplying neural activation by uncalibrated ultrasound geometric factors (f_L * f_V * cos(alpha)) amplifies measurement tracking noise, resulting in higher prediction variance than direct linear sEMG.
stage4_m4_falsification_mechanisms.mechanism_4_statistical_power_and_confid: With N=6 participants, statistical power to detect Delta R2 ~ 0.14 at alpha=0.05 is approximately 55%. The 95% confidence interval for paired Delta R2 (M4 - M1) is [-0.2815, +0.0061], which crosses zero. The paired t-test yields p = 0.0571 (Wilcoxon p = 0.0625), which fails to reject H0 at alpha=0.05. Therefore, it is strictly prohibited to declare M1 superior at alpha=0.05, while the sample point-estimate favors M1 by +0.1377.
stage4_m4_falsification_mechanisms.mechanism_5_model_scope_limitation: The evaluated model is an uncalibrated linear fit of a single engineered composite feature (a * f_L * f_V * cos(alpha) * d_MA), formally designated ENGINEERED_FEATURE_M4_NO_VERIFIED_ADVANTAGE. The full multi-scale physiological ODE of SUBJECT-01 (incorporating motor unit recruitment, activation-deactivation kinetics, non-linear tendon elasticity, and multi-muscle joint balance) was not evaluated in this linear feature test and remains unfalsified (FULL_SUBJECT01_MULTISCALE_ARCHITECTURE_NOT_FALSIFIED_BY_THIS_TEST).
stage4_m4_falsification_mechanisms.registry_action: Preserve NEG-0039 in negative_results.json with exact statistical interpretation.

radar_generalization_collapse_finding.scientific_conclusion: CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC AUDIT: The specific uncalibrated UWB Ridge regression model (204 raw frequency channels) collapses under cross-subject Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation (R2 = -2.4457 +/- 2.2077), failing on 5 of 6 held-out human participants despite achieving intra-participant R2 = 0.9763. This collapse is specific to this linear uncalibrated Ridge implementation and must not be extrapolated to declare all UWB technologies unusable, nor to non-linear architectures (LME with random intercepts, LSTM with recurrent memory, Random Forest) without explicit cross-subject LOSO evaluation.
